name: Starlit Library
notes: Dependency framework used by Zombies Crash Through Windows; current Workshop supports Build 42.

name: DEZ - Dynamic Evolution Z
notes: Server-side evolution logic; upstream warns against Wandering, Starving, and Thump with Friends.

name: LED Lantern
notes: B42 multiplayer-tagged lighting utility; supports flashlight-dependent play.

name: Surviving the Storm
notes: B42.20 reviewed; SP and hosted-MP behavior documented; dedicated feedback still requested upstream.

name: Reactive Sound Events
notes: Excellent SP atmosphere and physical scenes; current B42.20 MP comments still request stable MP updates.

name: Bleak World - Horror [B42]
notes: SOLO Fear Pass visual baseline: dark desaturation, fog, horror shaders and zombie textures. Do not combine with Afraid of Monsters zombie retextures.

name: Special Zombies Framework
notes: Framework for current special-zombie series; multiplayer synchronization is documented, dedicated runtime still needs project testing.

name: Special Zombies #01 - Screamer
notes: Rare screamer attracts nearby zombies; multiplayer state/audio synchronization documented.

name: Hark's Horde Night Revamped
notes: Explicit SP, hosted MP, and dedicated support; keep per-player horde sizes conservative.

name: Zombies Crash Through Windows [B41/42]
notes: Makes targeted zombies crash through windows with speed-aware animations and sandbox controls; removes the feeling that a closed room is automatically safe.

name: Afraid of Monsters zombies [B42 UPDATED]
notes: B42 adaptation; no longer SOLO default because it conflicts visually with Bleak World zombie retextures. Test as an alternate visual pack, not stacked.

name: Hibernating Zombies
notes: Single-player fully supported; MP is WIP. Candidate because dormancy may interfere with horde/event behavior.

name: Authentic Z
notes: B42 upstream support but recent B42.20/server issue reports; assets may not be reuploaded.

name: The Fog [B42] [Alpha]
notes: Early alpha and forces several world/zombie settings; SOLO laboratory only, not default.

name: Lingering Whispers...
notes: Excellent concept and tagged B42/MP, but late-August 2026 comments report current errors after a game update. Re-evaluate after upstream fix.

name: They Fear the Light
notes: Official DEZ compatibility exists, but current loud-audio and night-state reports require isolated B42.20 live testing before default use.

name: Horde Night
notes: Superseded in default profiles by HHNR, which has clearer current B42 stable multiplayer/dedicated support.

name: Occult Zombies (B42)
notes: Recent B42.20 users report working SP/MP. Test separately because custom zombie visuals/spawns may conflict with Bleak World and other zombie appearance systems.

name: Bleak World [B42]
notes: Different removed Workshop item; do not confuse with maintained Bleak World - Horror 3403923830.

name: ZombieBuddy
notes: Java-mod framework required by Knox Acoustics. Manual Linux setup and Java approval required; current page/version support should be rechecked before enabling.

name: Knox Acoustics [B42]
notes: Physically modeled room/wall/distance acoustics; extremely strong immersion candidate but pre-release, extra CPU cost, and Java-framework setup make it opt-in for now.

name: ApocalipseBR Regioes
notes: Multiplayer-oriented region/boss framework; also works SP. Required by Projeto Nemesis and includes configurable sprinter screams that attract hordes.

name: ApocalipseBR Projeto Nemesis
notes: Relentless boss/stalker with positional audio and pressure spawning. Upstream is MP/dedicated-focused; test before making default SOLO content.

name: [B42] Reanimating Zombies
notes: Configurable delayed/progressive corpse reanimation is an excellent false-security system; current B42.20 and multiplayer behavior must be verified before promotion.

name: AoM ZED ANIMATIONS B42
notes: Not suitable as a clean reproducible dedicated/local layer due root animation replacement/server limitations.

name: Starving Zombies [B42]
notes: Corpse scent and wind behavior are thematically strong, but DEZ explicitly lists this behavior overhaul as incompatible; do not stack it with the default evolution system.

name: The Darkness Is Coming!
notes: Build 41 path; do not use in current B42.20 production.

name: Horde Night Fixed B42
notes: Removed/incompatible reports; superseded by maintained HHNR.
